listingTitle: Keep blocking Rust APIs off async executors
title: Keep blocking Rust APIs off async executors
why: Blocking an executor thread delays unrelated tasks and can exhaust the runtime under load.
suggestion: Use the runtime-native async API or move blocking work to spawn_blocking, unblock, or a dedicated thread.
limitations: Only fully qualified known-blocking APIs are recognized; aliases and wrappers require type resolution.
Runtime scheduling and actual operation cost are not inferred.
